lines.text: AMC ten tip! More right answers, more points? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 tip! More right answers, more points? Nope!

lines.text: Right earns six points, wrong earns zero, and a blank earns one point five.
lines.caption: Right earns 6 points, wrong earns 0, and a blank earns 1.5.

lines.text: Sheet A: sixteen right, nine wrong. Sheet B: fourteen right, eleven blank. Which wins?
lines.caption: Sheet A: 16 right, 9 wrong. Sheet B: 14 right, 11 blank. Which wins?

lines.text: Sheet A: sixteen times six is ninety-six.
lines.caption: Sheet A: 16 times 6 is 96.

lines.text: Sheet B: fourteen times six is eighty-four. Eleven blanks add sixteen point five.
lines.caption: Sheet B: 14 times 6 is 84. 11 blanks add 16.5.

lines.text: Eighty-four plus sixteen point five is one hundred point five.
lines.caption: 84 plus 16.5 is 100.5.

lines.text: Sheet B wins, with one hundred point five. That clears this season's AIME cutoff!
lines.caption: Sheet B wins, with 100.5. That clears this season's AIME cutoff!

lines.text: Did you pick B? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you pick B? Tell me below!
